Jordan (CS): quick capture from today's Evergreen pilot check-in. Key signals: 1) customers want per-route cost caps (to limit expensive embedding jobs), 2) lack of retry/error signals in Console makes troubleshooting slow, 3) one account reported degraded embedding recall for long PDFs, 4) ask for a short 'how-to' for chunking/cleanup. Marking as possible renewal risk if not addressed.

Nora - PM: thanks. Can we get repro data for the embeddings case? Also want to know how many accounts have asked for per-route controls.

Jordan (CS): dropped sample to CS-6012 and linked the transcript. Sample payload: ```{"file":"evg_case_12.pdf","chars":9400}``` They reported recall drop after ~7k tokens.

Hector (Support): logged two related tickets this month (INC-3220, INC-3245). I'll attach anonymized samples and flag them revenue-risk when appropriate.

Sofia (Eng): initial thought: chunking + OCR noise. If Jordan can confirm samples are available, I'll run a quick repro. If it's chunking we can recommend overlap + cleaning as interim.

Lia (Docs): I can author a 1-page best-practices note (chunking sizes, overlap %, simple OCR cleanup). Low effort.

Jordan (CS): csbot recorded signal: CS-6012 (Evergreen). Link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-6012

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-6012 (Evergreen). Priority: candidate.

Nora - PM: prioritization suggestion: 1) per-route cost caps (pilot), 2) retry/error visibility in Console, 3) embeddings repro + guidance, 4) publish docs. Agree?

Hector (Support): agree. I'll compile the count of related tickets and post in the groom to help prioritization.

Sofia (Eng): I can take the repro spike (1 week). Will post findings in CS-6012.

Lia (Docs): I'll draft the guide and aim to have it by EOD Wednesday.

Jordan (CS): drafting customer note: "we're opening a short pilot to test per-route caps and will share a quick guidance doc this week. Engineering will run a spike and we'll follow up with timelines."

Nora - PM: action items: Sofia -> repro (owner). Lia -> docs. Hector -> ticket counts + attach samples. Jordan -> customer comms. I'll book a 20-min groom tomorrow to scope the route-cap UI and billing instrumentation.

Jordan (CS): thanks all. If anyone sees higher urgency, flag it here.

csbot: Label update: CS-6012 tagged [candidate].
